## Corporate News

- Alibaba's AI chatbot Qwen [experienced a system outage](https://news.futunn.com/hk/post/68528836/alibaba-responds-to-qwen-s-system-crash) during a major Spring Festival promotional event, highlighting challenges in maintaining stability amid surging user engagement and intense AI competition in China.
- Tencent [launched internal testing](https://news.futunn.com/flash/19920046/tencent-cloud-desktop-agent-tool-workbuddy-initiates-internal-testing) of its new AI-powered desktop Agent tool, WorkBuddy, marking its entry into the desktop agent tool market.
- NetEase [received a reaffirmed "Overweight" rating](https://news.futunn.com/hk/post/68530839/jpmorgan-has-reaffirmed-its-overweight-rating-on-netease-09999-hk) from Morgan Stanley with a target price of HKD 295, citing attractive valuation, strong global gaming position, and overestimated concerns about VAT and competition, with earnings set to be released on February 11.
- Meituan [acquired Dingdong Maicai's China business for $717 million](https://news.futunn.com/hk/post/68485885/the-first-mega-sized-m-a-deal-in-the-local), integrating the grocery platform to expand its fresh produce delivery market share and create synergies with Xiaoxiang Supermarket, while Dingdong's stock dropped over 14% following the announcement.
- BYD [reported sales near a two-year low](https://news.google.?oc=5), reflecting persistent challenges in China's electric vehicle market.
- NIO [achieved its first-ever quarterly profit](https://news.futunn.com/hk/post/68483372/nio-achieved-its-first-ever-quarterly-profit-with-an-estimated) in Q4 2025 with an estimated operating profit of 700 million to 1.2 billion RMB, driven by higher sales, optimized product mix, and cost reductions, leading to a surge in its stock price.
- Xpeng [officially launched the XPENG GX](https://news.google.?oc=5), a luxury six-seat flagship SUV featuring advanced AI capabilities.
- Li Auto [announced the launch of the new generation L9 Livis edition](https://news.futunn.com/hk/post/68527699/li-auto-s-stock-rose-as-the-company-announced-the) with enhanced AI and intelligent driving features, priced at RMB 559,800, boosting its Hong Kong stock by 3.18%.
- Leap Motor [reported a 27% year-on-year increase in January deliveries](https://news.futunn.com/hk/post/68525462/leapmotor-s-shares-rose-as-january-deliveries-increased-by-27) to 32,059 units and raised its 2026 annual sales target to 1.05 million vehicles.
- Horizon Robotics [saw shares rise over 3%](https://news.futunn.com/hk/post/68465467/stock-movement-horizonrobot-w-09660-surged-over-3-in-the) as it accelerates ADAS market penetration with its Journey 6B chip, which holds nearly 50% market share in autonomous driving computing chips.
- Geekplus [announced 2025 annual orders of RMB 41.37 billion](https://news.futunn.com/hk/post/68522950/geekplus-w-02590-included-in-trading-with-annual-orders-exceeding), up 31.7% year-on-year, driven by global expansion and successful inclusion in the Hong Kong Stock Connect, reinforcing its leadership in the AI+robotics sector.
- Samsung [showcased its latest AI-driven HVAC solutions](https://news.samsung.com/global/interview-growth-through-hvac-samsung-leads-the-market-with-ai-and-hyperconnected-solutions) at AHR Expo 2026, emphasizing sustainable, high-efficiency products and a strategic push into the North American market.
- AMD [saw Cathie Wood’s ARK Funds increase holdings](https://news.google.?oc=5) in the company following a recent share price decline.
- OpenAI [released GPT-5.3-Codex](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE1WSFdyRV9lZDd3TTJWVlhKY1pWMTRaSHJaa0hLU05kTE1QcGVjRVdndHhuNnFhQW5ObmtkcFhpRm1wd21yU1o2dDRYUWE2aDJzX1p4ZERNVlZjSHlaMTl6Qw?oc=5) and [announced its new coding model helped build itself](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQbnY5a0U5cGNobEFWLVJVTklzRGlWT3dtQ192WF9vZ1I4NVRnNEdBNldyRGNsNGZjc0pKQjdSZTB6Qzd4TXhWdEdscVVNNHBjVERKal9vN0ZCdnNDeHBubjI1d0lIdHFQSndZUEtfVmJ6NTFGVjU4T21tN1dRYzU5eWhHc0VLVXZpS3ZSUWM2QV
